items.quote: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
items.claim: The children of Heth answered Abraham

items.quote: thou art a mighty prince among us:
items.claim: Abraham is a mighty prince among the children of Heth

items.quote: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
items.claim: The children of Heth will not withhold their sepulchers from Abraham
